question: On the F-2-3 personal details form, what should you write in the date of birth column for a parent or sibling who is no longer living?
reference: Write 'DECEASED'.

question: Which Korean embassies stopped issuing visa labels as of February 24, 2020?
reference: The Korean embassies in the United States, Japan and 24 European countries (Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary).
answer: The Korean Embassies in the United States of America, Japan, and 24 European countries stopped issuing visa labels as of February 24, 2020 [1]. The 24 European countries listed are Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, and Hungary [1]. All Korean Embassies will stop issuing visa labels from July 1, 2020 [1].

cited_passages.text:
Announcement of Label Free Visa Policy and Important Guidelines The Korean Embassies in the United States of America, Japan and 24 European Countries* no longer issue visa labels, as of 24th February, 2020.
* Europe (24 countries): Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary
※ All Korean Embassies will stop issuing visa labels from 1st July, 2020.
When visa applications are approved, the Embassy will notify applicants of their visa details by issuing ‘Visa Grant Notice’. (Visa Application Center may issue the document on behalf of the Embassy). All applicants can print out the document at any time, by entering passport information (passport number, name and date of birth).
‘Visa Grant Notice’ document can be used to prove visa status, whether he/she is a holder of a valid Korean visa. Also, all visa holders are required to present the document to immigration officers during immigration clearance.
The document is valid printed either in color, or in black and white. Please refer to the ‘Note’ in the document for detailed information.
【How to verify and print out ‘Visa Grant Notice’】
1) Go to www.visa.go.kr - Application Status/Issue - Click ‘Check Application Status & Print’ menu. 2) Enter your Passport number, Name and Date of Birth, and Click the ‘Search’ button. 3) If your visa application is approved, the ‘Certificate’ button will be activated. 4) Click the button and print out the ‘Visa Grant Notice’.

question: On the personal details form for an F-2-3 or marriage migrant visa, if you have visited Korea more than 3 times, which visit do you give details about?
reference: The most recent visit.
answer: If you have visited the Republic of Korea more than 3 times, you must provide details about the most recent visit [1]. This rule applies to the personal details form for an F-2-3 visa application [2] and also to the form for a marriage migrant visa [3], as well as the marriage statement for an F-2-3 visa [4]. The same requirement is found on the general Korean Visa Portal form [5] and the official application instructions [6].

cited_passages.text:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the qualifications stated in the 「Higher Education Act」, and plans to engage in education or research·guidance of the professional field at educational institutions of higher than the college level or any of the equivalents

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

The head of a university (i.e. chancellor, or dean), a professor, associate professor, assistant professor, lecturer with concurrent posts, honorary professor, visiting scholar, or an exchange professor who plans to teach or research at a community college or above for at least 91 days.

1. A chancellor or dean refers to the head of a university who is hired by a prescribed procedure and oversees school affairs and faculties, and teaches students
2. A professor, associate professor, or assistant professor refers to an instructor whose qualification is acknowledged by the Human Resources Committee or Teacher’s Personnel Committee of a respective university, or who meets the requirements set forth as Article 16 of the Higher Education Act, and teaches and guides students and conduct academic research.
3. A lecturer with concurrent posts refers to a lecturer who meets the requirements set forth as Article 16 of the Higher Education Act and who has expertise in the relevant field
4. A honorary professor refers to a professor who has made remarkable achievements in education and academics ,and who has been designated by the enforcement decree of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
5. A visiting scholar refers to a professor who meets the requirements set forth as Article 16 of the Higher Education Act (However, if the school hires him/her for a specific class, he/she does not have to meet the requirements.)
6. Exchange professor refers to a professor dispatched to a university in ROK from a foreign university in accordance with the exchange agreement between the two universities.

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A degree certificate and a certificate of employment history
③ An employment contract, or confirmation of prospective employment
④ Documents related to establishment of an inviting university
- A copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register
⑤ A copy of an agreement for an exchange professor to ROK, or a dispatch order (for eligible applicant only)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An advanced science and technology expert recommended by the Minister of Education, Science and Technology of ROK who plans to teach or research at an academic institution such as a community college or higher

1. A person with a doctoral degree in science, technology, engineering, or math.
2. A person with a master's degree in science, technology, engineering, or math and at least 3 years of work experience in research and development of the field.
3. A professor of a field recognized as a new growth engine for the national development who is invited for the WCU project (a project to enhance research capacity of a university to world-class) operated by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology of ROK.

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② An employment contract, or confirmation of prospective employment
③ An employment recommendation letter for an advanced science and technology worker.
- If you wish to work in Korean Free Economic Zone, you must submit an employment recommendation letter or a document proving the necessity of employment issued by the respective mayor or provincial governor.
④ A document relevant to the establishment of the host institution (A copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register)
⑤ A copy of an official document in regards to BK21, or a copy of an official document in regards to the WCU Project (a project to enhance university's research capacity to a world-class level). (only for those applicable to this condition)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for your period of stay.

question: Under Table 1 (Detailed Standards for Administrative Sanctions) of the regulation on group e-visa application agencies, what sanction applies to an agency with no sanctions in the last 3 months that averaged fewer than 300 tourists over the last 3 months and whose tourists include 7 to 8 illegal stayers?
reference: Suspension of agency operation for 3 months.
answer: For an agency with no prior sanctions in the last 3 months and fewer than 300 average tourists over the last 3 months, having 7 to 8 illegal stayers results in a **Suspension (2 months)** [1]. This sanction applies when the rate of illegal stay is between 1.5% and less than 2.0%, calculated based on the number of illegal stayers divided by the average number of visa issued persons in the last 3 months [1]. The calculation of the rate uses the number of illegal stayers from the previous month divided by the average number of visa issued persons in the last 3 months, provided this average was 300 people or more; if it was less than 300, the number of illegal stayers is counted directly [2].

question: An administrative staff member of a foreign embassy in Korea applies for an A-2 visa at a Korean embassy. What kind of visa can they get and how long can they stay?
reference: They can apply for a single-entry or a multiple-entry visa and may stay in Korea until the end of their assignment.
answer: An administrative staff member of a foreign embassy in Korea applies for an A-2 visa at a Korean embassy. They can get either a single-entry or multiple-entry visa and will be allowed to stay in Korea until the end of their assignment [6].

question: According to the e-visa issuance confirmation, by when must an e-visa holder enter Korea, and does the e-visa guarantee entry?
reference: They must enter Korea before the e-visa's expiry date. It does not guarantee entry, because the holder may still be denied entry during immigration clearance at the port of entry.
answer: An e-visa holder must enter the Republic of Korea before its expiry date [1, 2, 3]. Even with an e-visa, entry may be denied during immigration clearance at the port of entry [1, 2, 3].

question: A university lecturer is invited to give lectures in Korea for less than 90 days. Which visa applies if they receive no compensation other than flight and accommodation, and if they are paid, what contract or invitation document must the C-4 application include?
reference: With no compensation other than flight and accommodation, they are eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa. If paid (C-4), they submit an employment contract on providing lectures or public speeches, or an invitation card that indicates the lecture fees.
answer: If the university lecturer receives no compensation other than flight and accommodation, they are eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa instead of the C-4 visa [1]. If they receive payment, they must include an employment contract or an invitation card indicating lecture fees in their application [1].

question: For an E-10-2 fishing ship crew visa, how long must the seafarer labor contract be and how large must the vessel be?

question: For the D-8-4 technology and business startup visa, who issues the OASIS program completion or graduation certificate that can be submitted as proof of points?
reference: The head of the Global Investment Center designated by the Minister of Justice.
answer: The OASIS program completion or graduation certificate for the D-8-4 visa is issued by the head of the Global Investment Center designated by the Minister of Justice of ROK [1]. It can also be issued by the head of the Global Investment Center designated by the Minister of Justice [2].

question: A Chinese national whose son is a diplomat stationed in Korea wants to visit him on her own with a C-3-1 visa applied for at the embassy. Which documents are required?
reference: The visa application form (Form No. 17), passport, a standard photo and the fee; an official letter from the Minister of Foreign Affairs of her country asking for cooperation; and a certificate of family relation and other documents proving the family relationship (such as a household register booklet or hukou).
answer: The required documents are a Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee, and an official document verifying you are overseas Koreans with foreign nationality [4]. question: What must a D-2-6 exchange student submit to show they have completed at least one semester?
reference: Proof of enrollment from a university.
answer: To show they have completed at least one semester, an applicant must submit documents proving their enrollment from a university [1].

cited_passages.title: Visa guide: D-2-6 Exchange Student
cited_passages.text:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

An exchange student who plans to study for a required course/curriculum in accordance with an agreement of exchange program between corresponding universities

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An exchange student who plans to study, according to a degree exchange program between universities

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate (or Registration Number Certificate) of a respective education institute
③ Standard Acceptance Letter* (issued by the dean/president of the university)
④ Original copy of documents proving your financial ability to support yourself
- When submitting a parent's bank statement, family relation certificate is required to submit.
⑤ Recommendation letter issued by the head of your university
⑥ Documents proving that you are an exchange student (official documents of the host university, exchange student agreement between universities)
⑦ Documents proving that you have completed at least one semester (Proof of enrollment from a university)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: How much money must a parent have in the bank to get an F-1-13 visa as the parent of an international student?
reference: Not in the corpus. The F-1-13 page asks for a balance statement showing that the standard amount has been deposited for at least 1 month, but does not state the amount.
answer: The passages do not specify the exact amount of money required, only that the applicant must provide a Balance Statement proving that the standard amount of money has been deposited for at least 1 month [1].
